items.exampleEn: Children can be surprisingly perceptive about adults' moods.
items.exampleZh: 孩子對大人的情緒可能出奇地敏銳。

items.exampleEn: Only a cynic would think she helped him for money.
items.exampleZh: 只有憤世嫉俗的人，才會認為她是為了錢才幫他。
items.glossZh: 憤世嫉俗的人；凡事懷疑的人

items.exampleEn: The architects envisage a park on the roof of the building.
items.exampleZh: 建築師們設想在大樓屋頂上蓋一座公園。

items.exampleEn: The advertisement persuasively shows how easy the product is to use.
items.exampleZh: 這支廣告很有說服力地展示了產品有多容易使用。

items.exampleEn: Some people cynically believe that every free gift has a hidden cost.
items.exampleZh: 有些人抱著懷疑的態度，認為每份免費禮物都有隱藏的代價。

items.exampleEn: The writer checked the plausibility of every detail in her novel.
items.exampleZh: 作者檢查了小說中每個細節是否合理。

items.exampleEn: The cat could plausibly have opened the door by itself.
items.exampleZh: 那隻貓很有可能是自己把門打開的。

items.exampleEn: No one can credibly claim that the test was easy.
items.exampleZh: 沒有人能令人信服地說這次考試很簡單。

items.sentenceEn: She argued persuasively for a longer lunch break.
items.sentenceZh: 她很有說服力地爭取延長午休時間。

items.audioEn: Even the cynics in our office were impressed by the new manager's first week.
items.audioZh: 就連我們辦公室裡那些凡事懷疑的人，也對新經理的第一週印象深刻。
items.questionZh: 辦公室裡那些凡事懷疑的人有什麼反應？
options: They wanted to leave the company.

items.sentenceEn: I can't envisage working anywhere else.
items.sentenceZh: 我無法想像在別的地方工作。

items.sentenceEn: He smiled cynically when the boss promised a pay rise.
items.sentenceZh: 老闆答應加薪時，他冷冷地笑了一下。

items.stemEn: The new evidence adds to the ____ of her explanation.
items.stemZh: 新的證據增加了她說法的可信度。

items.stemEn: She is a ____ observer who notices every small change.
items.stemZh: 她是個敏銳的觀察者，會注意到每個小變化。

items.passageEn: When our team presented a plan for a four-day work week, I expected the managers to react cynically. Our director is a well-known cynic who rarely likes new ideas. However, Mia, our team leader, spoke persuasively. She could credibly show that two similar companies had kept their profits after making the change. She also answered a perceptive question about customer service with a clear plan. The director said he could envisage a six-month trial, and that the plan could plausibly save money on electricity, even if the savings were only marginal. In the end, the trial was approved.
items.passageZh: 我們團隊提出每週上班四天的計畫時，我以為主管們會冷嘲以對。我們的總監是出了名的懷疑論者，很少喜歡新點子。不過，我們的組長 Mia 說得很有說服力。她能可信地證明，兩家類似的公司在改制後仍維持獲利。對於一個關於客戶服務的敏銳提問，她也提出了清楚的計畫。總監說，他可以設想先試行六個月，而且這個計畫說得通、能省下電費，即使省下的錢可能不多。最後，試行計畫獲得批准。

options: 公司要先問過所有客人

items.promptZh: 他說得很可信，大家都相信了。
referenceEn: He spoke so credibly that everyone believed him.
He spoke credibly, and everyone believed him.
rubricZh: credibly 是副詞，修飾動詞，表示「可信地」（例如 spoke credibly 等）
「大家都相信了」可寫，例如 everyone believed him、all of us believed him 等

items.promptZh: 她設想自己五年後開一家小書店。
referenceEn: She envisages opening a small bookshop in five years.
She envisages that she will open a small bookshop five years from now.
rubricZh: 「設想」用 envisage，可接動名詞或 that 子句（例如 envisages opening…、envisages that she will… 等）
「五年後」可寫，例如 in five years、five years from now 等
「小書店」可寫，例如 a small bookshop、a little bookstore 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：評分要點過嚴：寫「envisage 後接名詞或動名詞」，但 envisage that＋子句（I envisage that I will…）也正確，會被誤判；宜改「可接名詞、動名詞或 that 子句（例如…）」。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為「envisage 可接名詞、動名詞或 that 子句，表示「設想」（例如 envisage living…、envisage that I will…）」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（混合詞性題至少兩個干擾項放得進空格）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: plausibility、inexplicably 換成同單元形容詞 plausible、speculative（a ____ observer 不通）；不用 credible

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長新規則（只看英文）修正：只看英文時 speculative 放進句中仍說得通（a speculative observer who notices every small change）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: speculative 換成 meaningless（u06-l04；a meaningless observer 語意不通、仍合文法，混合詞性題保留兩個合文法的干擾項）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：envisage 可接名詞、動名詞或 that 子句，表示「設想」（例如 envisage living…、envisage that I will… 等）
